label: Dubstep / Deathstep (Metal-Influenced, Dark)
tempo_line: Tempo as written 130-150 BPM, felt half-time 65-75 BPM
tempo_note: Tempo is written the sourced dubstep way: 140 BPM, felt half-time as 70 (drumstep: about 172-174, felt 86-87). The official melodic dubstep cards say 171 for the same kind of music. Compare by ear before trusting either.
note: Studio-authored recipe, not an official Music 3 template, untested (nothing has been rendered from it yet).

cards.mood: A slow, doom-laden cinematic intro builds from a low drone and a distant choir pad to a pounding, ominous first drop. A breakdown leaves a heavy, guitar-like riff and a ticking beat, then the second drop intensifies with faster kick runs…
cards.vocal: No lead singer. Low, spoken-style fragments and distorted, wordless vocal textures act as sound effects in the intro and between the drops.
cards.palette: A growling, atonal mid-bass with formant-style movement and machine-gun triplet bursts drives the drops over a cavernous sub.
cards.tempo_line: written 140 BPM, felt half-time as 70 BPM

cards.mood: Savage and relentless: a spoken warning over a bare drone becomes a barrage of kick and bass hits. Growled and screamed phrases land on the beat between the drops, a breakdown strips to a choir pad and a heavy riff, and the final drop is…
cards.vocal: Singer A (Male). The vocalist possesses a harsh, guttural timbre built on low growls and high screams, with a rough, aggressive edge.
cards.palette: Deep, guttural bass growls with heavy distortion and triplet machine-gun runs carry the drops, with the screamed vocal phrases trading lines with the bass.
cards.tempo_line: written 150 BPM, felt half-time as 75 BPM
